task.description:
Validate API-06 (Pagination) for release readiness.

API-06 requires:
- All list endpoints support cursor-based pagination
- Page size configurable (default 50, max 200)
- Cursors are opaque base64-encoded strings
- Cursors expire after 24h → HTTP 410
- Cross-endpoint cursor rejection
- Response includes cursor when more pages exist, absent on last page

Verify:
1. All API-06 acceptance criteria from docs/requirements/API-06.md are met
2. Test report shows all tests passing (37/37 API-06 tests)
3. All 4 endpoints use shared pagination module (T:, I:, D:, H: prefixes)
4. No regressions (210 pass, 102 skip, 0 fail)

If PASS, update docs/status/requirement_status.json:
- Set API-06 status to "RELEASED"
- Set released_at to current timestamp
- Set release_run to "WF02-api06-20260523"

Write release decision to docs/status/release-API-06-20260523.json

result.summary: Release APPROVED for API-06 (Pagination). All 37 API-06 tests pass with zero failures. Build and full test suite pass (210 pass, 0 fail, 102 skip). NFR benchmarks are a known stub and do not block this release — pagination is a pure API contract module with no I/O or database performance characteristics of its own.
